name: I Love Kanji
line: Learn 2,200 kanji from N5 to N1 four ways: flashcards, quizzes, Kanji Math and drawing.
facts: Flashcards: recall what each kanji means, then flip to check
Quiz: pick the right reading of a real Japanese word
Kanji Math: build each kanji from its parts, like 一 + 人 = 大, with a memory tip for why they fit
Drawing: watch the stroke order, then write the kanji with your finger, every stroke checked
Each method has its own smart reviews, right before you'd forget
N5 is free with every feature
